categories.job_en: Identify the primary constraint and choose the smallest evidence-backed execution route
categories.job_zh: 识别首要增长约束，并选择最小且有证据支撑的执行路径

categories.job_en: Define customer, market, fit, positioning, growth model, and strategic choices
categories.job_zh: 定义客户、市场、匹配、定位、增长模型与战略选择

categories.job_en: Turn strategy, customer evidence, and proof into governed content and creative assets
categories.job_zh: 把战略、客户证据与证明转化为受治理的内容和创意资产

categories.job_en: Connect qualified demand to the product through channels, campaigns, search, paid media, partnerships, and outbound
categories.job_zh: 通过渠道、营销活动、搜索、广告、合作与外联，把有效需求连接到产品

categories.job_en: Move qualified visitors and new users to first value and the next meaningful action
categories.job_zh: 推动有效访客和新用户到达首次价值与下一项关键行动

categories.job_en: Sustain recurring value, understand cohorts and churn, and recover valuable customer relationships
categories.job_zh: 维持持续价值，理解同期群与流失，并修复有价值的客户关系

categories.job_en: Convert customer value into durable revenue through pricing, packaging, LTV, and unit economics
categories.job_zh: 通过定价、套餐、LTV 与单位经济，把客户价值转化为可持续收入

categories.job_en: Create deeper value and new distribution through referrals, loops, expansion, marketplaces, and network effects
categories.job_zh: 通过推荐、增长循环、客户扩张、多边市场与网络效应创造更深价值和新分发

categories.job_en: Make growth observable, explainable, forecastable, and causally testable
categories.job_zh: 让增长可观察、可解释、可预测并可进行因果验证

categories.job_en: Build the planning, decision, data, operating, governance, and organizational systems that make growth repeatable
categories.job_zh: 构建规划、决策、数据、运营、治理与组织系统，让增长可以重复运行
